# SvgPageExportOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options controlling how a document page is exported to SVG.

All fields are optional; the defaults produce compact, deterministic, standalone SVG suitable for website thumbnails and CI snapshots.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`captureLayout`](#capturelayout): Capture a `LayoutSnapshot` of the rendered element tree (types, parent relationships, and per-page rectangles) and return it on the export result.
- [`embedImages`](#embedimages): How raster images should be represented.
- [`includeAccessibilityMetadata`](#includeaccessibilitymetadata): Include `<title>`, `<desc>`, `role`, and `aria-label` on the root `<svg>` element.
- [`maxPages`](#maxpages): Maximum number of pages to emit.
- [`precision`](#precision): Decimal places for generated coordinates.
- [`shapeRendering`](#shaperendering): Value for the root `shape-rendering` attribute.
- [`signal`](#signal): Cancels the export.
- [`title`](#title): Human-readable document title used to build the `<title>`/`aria-label` when `includeAccessibilityMetadata` is set.

### `captureLayout`

```typescript
captureLayout?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Capture a [`LayoutSnapshot`](layout-snapshot.md) of the rendered element tree (types, parent relationships, and per-page rectangles) and return it on the export result. Off by default and zero-cost when off: with no recorder attached, the layout pass is byte-identical to normal output. Used by the previewer's structure view to highlight where each element landed.

### `embedImages`

```typescript
embedImages?: "omit" | "data-uri" | "external-ref" | undefined
```

*optional*

How raster images should be represented. `data-uri` (default) is best for standalone website thumbnails - the SVG carries the image bytes inline and needs no asset coordination. `omit` drops images entirely.

### `includeAccessibilityMetadata`

```typescript
includeAccessibilityMetadata?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Include `<title>`, `<desc>`, `role`, and `aria-label` on the root `<svg>` element. This is a lightweight preview affordance, not PDF/UA structure export. Defaults to true.

### `maxPages`

```typescript
maxPages?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Maximum number of pages to emit. The full document is still laid out (so pagination/overflow stays correct), but only the first `maxPages` pages are serialized to SVG. Omit (or use a non-positive value) to export every page. Useful for preview/thumbnail pipelines that only need the first few pages.

### `precision`

```typescript
precision?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Decimal places for generated coordinates. Defaults to 3 for stable, compact output.

### `shapeRendering`

```typescript
shapeRendering?: "crispEdges" | "auto" | "optimizeSpeed" | "geometricPrecision" | undefined
```

*optional*

Value for the root `shape-rendering` attribute. Defaults to `auto` (the SVG default), which keeps antialiased curves/charts looking smooth. Set to `crispEdges` for pages dominated by pixel-grid graphics (barcodes, QR, Data Matrix) so abutting module rectangles snap to the device pixel grid and don't leave faint anti-aliasing seams between modules. Text is governed by `text-rendering`, so it is unaffected either way.

### `signal`

```typescript
signal?: AbortSignal | undefined
```

*optional*

Cancels the export. Checked before it starts and between its stages; when aborted, the promise rejects with the signal's reason.

### `title`

```typescript
title?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Human-readable document title used to build the `<title>`/`aria-label` when `includeAccessibilityMetadata` is set. Defaults to the document metadata title, then a generic label.
